keyFeatures: Self-rating across 6 life areas to measure your fixed-to-growth mindset ratio
Based on Carol Dweck's foundational research on growth mindset from Stanford
Identifies specific domains where fixed beliefs may be holding you back
Actionable reframes to shift from a fixed to a growth orientation in each area
tips: Be honest about fixed mindset areas — most people have growth mindset in some domains and fixed mindset in others, and that's normal.
Notice the language you use when you struggle: 'I can't do this' (fixed) vs. 'I can't do this yet' (growth) — that one word makes a measurable difference.
